snippet.title: Steel Swarm: SURVIVOR - Game & Demo Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Steel Swarm: SURVIVOR is a fast-paced roguelite survivors game where you obliterate swarms with your drones. Set up formations, upgrade your drones, and overwhelm hordes of metal in each run. Take on enemy waves solo or in multiplayer co-op!

PLAY THE DEMO ON STEAM
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4307100

DRONE FORMATIONS
Adapt to the evolving threats with custom formations. Mix and match drones, upgrade them, and annihilate enemy waves by turning your squad into a lethal instrument of war.

RICH META PROGRESSION
Discover blueprints, craft gadgets, and unlock formation templates for more strategic options. Each run contributes to a persistent progression layer that rewards experimentation and mastery.

MULTIPLAYER CO-OP
Face the enemy alone or join forces with friends for greater destruction. Make synergistic builds and combine formations to eradicate hordes of metal in coordination.

TOTAL DESTRUCTION
Beyond dense swarms and explosives, experience reactive environments that shatter in battle. As you lead the chaos, the battlefield shall become a living canvas of metal and sparks.

NARRATIVE DEPTH
Learn about a world of intrigue through missions, logs, and world events. A story of conflicting perspectives will unveil as you traverse the continent and rebel against the authority.
